purpose: Replication of btc_multifactor_v1 on Hyperliquid (HYPE) options: Double Heston vs Single Heston vs per-expiry Black-Scholes, every model calibrated per date, scored on held-out options. Rules fixed before any HYPE option surface is fetched or any model fitted.
venue: Deribit linear HYPE_USDC options, USDC-settled (listed since 2026-06-22)

sources.spot: artifacts/hype_perp_daily.json (Hyperliquid HYPE perpetual daily closes, public info API)

convention: Deribit quotes HYPE_USDC option prices in USDC as the undiscounted Black-76 price on the expiry forward (same as XRP_USDC). Checked on one trade before freezing: Black-76 on the index gives 26.35 vs 26.71 traded for a deep ITM 3-month call, consistent with forward above index; the pipeline solves the forward per trade.
forward: Per trade, solve for F from (price, trade iv, K, tau) under the convention. Per expiry, take the median of F/index over the day's trades. Each quote's forward is that ratio times the index at its own trade time.
quote: Last trade per instrument in the window. Primary target: trade price. Secondary robustness target: the exchange mark price at that trade.

date_rule.dates: EVERY calendar day from first_date to last_date is a test date (options history is too short for an episode sample).
date_rule.regime_label: Secondary label only: a date is 'shock' if it is 1-8 days after an onset (RV10 / median RV10 over previous 60 days >= 1.5, de-duplicated over 20 days, onsets searched from 2026-06-01), otherwise 'other'. Computed from spot alone before any option fetch.

designs.B_heldout_expiries: PRIMARY. Sort a date's expiries by maturity; hold out every odd-ranked expiry except the longest. Calibrate on the rest; score all quotes of held-out expiries.
designs.A_heldout_strikes: SECONDARY. Within each expiry, sort by strike; hold out odd-ranked strikes.

models.BS_EXPIRY: One Black-76 volatility per calibration expiry (grouped by the expiry column, per btc AMENDMENT_01). Other expiries: linear total-variance interpolation between expiry knots, flat outside.
models.SH: Heston, all five parameters calibrated per date and design; feller_free.
models.DH: Double Heston, separable four-shock literature_exact convention, slow-first ordering, all ten parameters calibrated per date and design; feller_free.

variants: Fixed in advance to feller_free for both SH and DH, inherited from the BTC validation choice (btc_multifactor_v1/artifacts/variant_selection.json). No XRP date is used for any choice.
bounds_note: Identical to BTC so this is a clean replication; the binding vol-of-vol bound is reported, not changed.
objective: Mean squared vega-weighted price residual, identical to BTC.
primary_endpoint: All usable dates, design B. Unit = ISO week: average the per-date paired differences in held-out IV RMSE (SH - DH, BS_EXPIRY - DH) within each week. DH beats a competitor only if the one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test over weeks gives p < 0.05 AND the week-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound of the mean difference is > 0 (5,000 replicates, seed 20260920).
secondary: shock-window and other dates separately (unit = episode for shock, week for other)
integrity: Dates are all calendar days in the window; regime labels come from spot realised volatility alone before any HYPE option data is fetched.
No filter, split, metric, bound, optimizer setting or endpoint changes after fits are seen.
Failed dates, fits and fallbacks are retained and disclosed.
Trade prices are not synchronized bid/ask; no spread-based claims.

Pre-freeze contact with HYPE option data: instrument list (creation dates, current 6 expiries), first-page daily trade counts on 8 dates to find the launch, and one trade to confirm the price convention.
filters_note: min price = 2 ticks (tick 0.002 USDC); other filters identical to XRP.
